message.content: {"note_claim": "Cancer exists and is caused by uncontrolled cell growth, not parasites; tumors are not parasites or their eggs.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Cancer is a group of diseases where abnormal cells grow out of control and crowd out normal cells.", "reason": "The ACS page defines cancer as a real disease of uncontrolled abnormal cell growth caused by gene changes, with no mention of parasites, which substantiates the note's core claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Cancer exists and is caused by uncontrolled cell growth, not parasites; tumors are not parasites or their eggs.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Cancer is a group of diseases where abnormal cells grow out of control and crowd out normal cells.
parsed.reason: The ACS page defines cancer as a real disease of uncontrolled abnormal cell growth caused by gene changes, with no mention of parasites, which substantiates the note's core claim.
